name: repocortex
description: Deterministic code intelligence and change safety for AI coding agents, served from a local code graph.
long_description:
RepoCortex indexes a repository into a local SQLite code graph of symbols, references, APIs, database access, tests, configuration and Git history, and serves it to an AI agent over MCP. Every relationship carries a confidence level and the source location that justifies it.

This bundle runs `repocortex serve` over stdio against the repository you choose. The repository must already have an index: the server does not build one, and exits with an error when `.repocortex/index.db` is missing. Create it once from a terminal with `repocortex init`, `repocortex index` and `repocortex resolve`.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: The root of the repository to serve. It must already be indexed with `repocortex init` and `repocortex index`.
